visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a wide shot of a traditional street-side food stall in Taiwan. An older female worker with dark hair, wearing a striped shirt and a green apron, is busy preparing food behind a metal counter. In front of the stall, a small red table and plastic stools are set up on the sidewalk. (2) A close-up shot follows, showing a 'Bawan' (meatball) in a bowl smothered in a thick orange sauce and garnished with fresh cilantro. A silver spoon lifts a generous piece of the translucent, chewy skin to reveal the meat filling inside. (3) The camera shifts to a large, shallow metal pan where dozens of meatballs are being gently deep-fried in bubbling oil. The meatballs are pale and round, partially submerged in the liquid. (4) Hands are seen using metal scissors to cut the meatballs into smaller pieces within a bowl, followed by a ladle pouring a translucent, savory sauce over the freshly cut food. (5) An extreme close-up highlights the interior of the meatball, showing chunks of marinated pork and slices of bamboo shoot. A spoon then scoops bright red chili sauce from a glass jar and adds it to the bowl. (6) A bowl of clear soup containing pork intestines is shown, with a spoon lifting the ingredients to demonstrate their cleanliness and texture. (7) The video concludes with a shot of the shop's red and white signage featuring Chinese characters and prices, followed by a wide street view of the stall with customers seated outside under a yellow and red striped awning.
